versions.changelog:
Initial release of the “marketing” comprehensive skill set.

- Provides 8 marketing sub-skills: SEO content optimization, brand voice review, ad compliance check, campaign planning, social media trend tracking, competitor tracking, marketing performance analysis, and copywriting.
- Uses an intent recognition and routing system to match user input to appropriate sub-skills.
- Enforces strict template-based execution for each sub-skill, including required inputs, process steps, output formats, and quality standards.
- Integrates compliance and brand consistency checks for relevant sub-skills, ensuring outputs meet regulatory and brand guidelines.
- Aligns with a six-step closed-loop workflow, supporting full-cycle task execution, validation, and review.
